_comment: Small hand-picked pool of candidate tasks for the Shaper (dev domains) and extra simulation items for the Critic (both splits). Distilled from the trajectory-style datasets described in ../datasets/README.md; real Mind2Web / ALFRED samples for the Critic's simulations live in ../datasets/samples/ (see scripts/fetch_dataset_samples.py).

email_assistant.nl: Draft a reply to my professor asking for a two-day extension on the assignment, and keep it formal.
If my manager hasn't replied by Friday, send a polite follow-up; otherwise do nothing.

web_navigation.nl: Go to the flight booking site, search flights from Tel Aviv to Berlin next Tuesday, and list the three cheapest options.
On the electronics store, filter laptops to 16 GB RAM or more under $1,200, and add the best-rated one to the cart.

code_task.nl: Given a list of file paths, delete every file older than 30 days unless it's in the 'archive' folder.

embodied_task.nl: Rinse the mug in the sink, then put it in the coffee maker.
Put both pillows from the sofa onto the armchair, one at a time.

trip_planning.nl: Plan a 3-day itinerary in Kyoto that includes at least one temple per day and avoids anything more than a 20-minute walk from the last stop.

customer_support.nl: If the customer's order is late and they're a first-time buyer, offer a 10% discount; if they're a repeat buyer, offer free expedited shipping instead.
